conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()

import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute('CREATE TABLE Twitter (name TEXT, retrieved INTEGER, friends INTEGER)')
seed = [
    ('drchuck', 1, 4),
    ('opencontent', 1, 3),
    ('lhawthorn', 1, 2),
    ('steve_coppin', 0, 1),
    ('davidkocher', 0, 1),
    ('hrheingold', 0, 1),
]
for row in seed:
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO Twitter (name, retrieved, friends) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', row)
conn.commit()

cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Twitter WHERE retrieved = 0')
print('waiting: %d' % cur.fetchone()[0])

cur.execute('SELECT AVG(friends) FROM Twitter')
print('average: %s' % cur.fetchone()[0])

cur.execute('SELECT name FROM Twitter ORDER BY friends DESC LIMIT 1')
print('top: %s' % cur.fetchone()[0])

tests.code: assert 'waiting: 3' in __learner_output__, 'expected: waiting: 3 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__
assert 'average: 2.0' in __learner_output__, 'expected: average: 2.0 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__
assert 'top: drchuck' in __learner_output__, 'expected: top: drchuck | actual: %r' % __learner_output__

name.en: An independent check against the database itself

tests.code:
cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Twitter WHERE retrieved = 0')
waiting = cur.fetchone()[0]
assert waiting == 3, 'expected: 3 waiting in the table | actual: %r' % (waiting,)

import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute('CREATE TABLE People (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE)')
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE Follows (from_id INTEGER, to_id INTEGER)')
for name in ['drchuck', 'opencontent', 'lhawthorn']:
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO People (name) VALUES (?)', (name,))
cur.execute('INSERT INTO Follows (from_id, to_id) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 2))
cur.execute('INSERT INTO Follows (from_id, to_id) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 3))
conn.commit()

cur.execute('SELECT Follows.to_id, People.name FROM Follows JOIN People ON Follows.to_id = People.id')
for row in cur:
    print('%d -> %s' % (row[0], row[1]))

tests.code:
cur.execute('SELECT Follows.to_id, People.name FROM Follows JOIN People ON Follows.to_id = People.id')
rows = cur.fetchall()
assert rows == [(2, 'opencontent'), (3, 'lhawthorn')], 'expected: two combined rows | actual: %r' % (rows,)

name.en: The output shows both names in arrow format

tests.code: assert '2 -> opencontent' in __learner_output__ and '3 -> lhawthorn' in __learner_output__, 'expected: 2 -> opencontent / 3 -> lhawthorn | actual: %r' % __learner_output__

import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute('CREATE TABLE genres (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE)')
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE artists (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE)')
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE albums (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, artist_id INTEGER, genre_id INTEGER, tracks INTEGER)')

for gid, gname in [(1, 'Tarab'), (2, 'Jazz'), (3, 'Folk')]:
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO genres (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (gid, gname))
for aid, aname in [(1, 'Fairuz'), (2, 'Ziad Rahbani'), (3, 'Marcel Khalife')]:
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO artists (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (aid, aname))
for title, artist_id, genre_id, tracks in [
    ('Ahdan', 1, 1, 8),
    ('Kifak Inta', 1, 1, 10),
    ('Ya Ana Ya Ana', 1, 1, 7),
    ('Ana Mosh Kafir', 2, 2, 6),
    ('Houdou Nisbi', 2, 2, 5),
    ('Wahin', 3, 3, 12),
]:
    cur.execute('INSERT INTO albums (title, artist_id, genre_id, tracks) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (title, artist_id, genre_id, tracks))
conn.commit()

cur.execute('SELECT albums.title, artists.name FROM albums JOIN artists ON albums.artist_id = artists.id')
for row in cur:
    print('album: %s / artist: %s' % (row[0], row[1]))

cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artists')
print('artists: %d' % cur.fetchone()[0])

cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM albums')
print('albums: %d' % cur.fetchone()[0])

cur.execute('SELECT genres.name FROM albums JOIN genres ON albums.genre_id = genres.id GROUP BY genres.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1')
print('top genre: %s' % cur.fetchone()[0])

cur.execute('SELECT AVG(tracks) FROM albums')
print('avg tracks: %.1f' % cur.fetchone()[0])

tests.code: assert 'artists: 3' in __learner_output__ and 'albums: 6' in __learner_output__, 'expected: artists: 3 / albums: 6 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__
assert 'top genre: Tarab' in __learner_output__, 'expected: top genre: Tarab | actual: %r' % __learner_output__
assert 'avg tracks: 8.0' in __learner_output__, 'expected: avg tracks: 8.0 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__

import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute('CREATE TABLE artists (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)')
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE albums (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, artist_id INTEGER)')

cur.execute('INSERT INTO artists (name) VALUES (?)', ('Fairuz',))
cur.execute('INSERT INTO artists (name) VALUES (?)', ('Ziad Rahbani',))
cur.execute('INSERT INTO albums (title, artist_id) VALUES (?, ?)', ('Ahdan', 1))
cur.execute('INSERT INTO albums (title, artist_id) VALUES (?, ?)', ('Kifak Inta', 1))
cur.execute('INSERT INTO albums (title, artist_id) VALUES (?, ?)', ('Houdou Nisbi', 2))
conn.commit()

cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM albums JOIN artists ON albums.artist_id = artists.id')  # قاعدة المطابقة تعود / the match rule returns
total = cur.fetchone()[0]
print('albums: %d' % total)

tests.code: assert 'albums: 3' in __learner_output__, 'expected: albums: 3 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__
assert __learner_output__.count('albums:') == 1, 'expected: exactly one albums line | actual: %r' % __learner_output__

name.ar: كل ألبوم وجد شريكه — تحقق مستقل
name.en: Every album found its partner — independent check

tests.code:
cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM albums')
albums_total = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM albums JOIN artists ON albums.artist_id = artists.id')
joined_total = cur.fetchone()[0]
assert albums_total == 3 and joined_total == albums_total, 'expected: 3 albums all matched | actual: %r' % ((albums_total, joined_total),)
